history_search.method: Search committed repository history for numeric RMSE/model-evaluation evidence and reconstruct the intervening dataset/methodology checkpoints. Ignored local run artifacts are not treated as historical authority.
history_search.result: Three unique committed return-model metric checkpoints are preserved: provider-boundary screening, PIT-core tournament smoke, and full-V1 Phase D. The full-V1 Phase B/C freeze is retained as a non-metric methodology breakpoint.

target.description: next observed session same-contract front-month settlement return

checkpoints.interpretation: The earliest preserved numeric return screen already found richer return features worse than the zero-return reference. It was screening evidence and not a research-promotion result.

target.construction: next-row log return of the noncanonical bootstrap market close

checkpoints.interpretation: This is the only preserved checkpoint where the configured Ridge/HistGB ladder ranked ahead of naive. The evidence itself labels the result pipeline-only, pit_core, noncanonical, incomplete, and ineligible for research promotion.

target.construction: next-session selected-contract within-contract settlement log return; cross-contract returns are prohibited

checkpoints.interpretation: This checkpoint is the methodology/comparability break between the PIT-core smoke and Phase D. No preserved model run exists on this freeze before Phase D, so the individual effects of the changed data representation, shorter window, and added feature families cannot be isolated retrospectively.

The first preserved model result after the full-V1 methodology break has both Ridge and HistGB worse than naive. The result was reproduced twice with identical evidence and all 24 prediction artifact hashes identical.

Post-closeout correctness hardening did not restore the PIT-smoke ranking. The locked environment reproduced the frozen Phase D result exactly, reducing support for an environment/software-drift explanation of the negative Phase D result.

changes: a provider-neutral canonical-contract dataset route was introduced
target construction moved to next-session within-contract settlement returns
M1-M4 market-structure features and lineage were added
full-V1 PIT exogenous families were present

divergence.reason: The PIT-smoke and Phase D RMSE values were produced on materially different datasets, return constructions, feature sets, train/OOS windows, evidence tiers, and evaluation gates. Their raw values can document historical movement but cannot measure a controlled regression.

cross_stage_descriptive_only.warning: These deltas are intentionally non-causal and non-comparable; they are included only to make the historical movement explicit.

methodology_changes_from_pit_smoke_to_ph.market_representation: noncanonical bootstrap close series -> provider-neutral selected-contract settlement path with governed roll semantics
methodology_changes_from_pit_smoke_to_ph.target_return_construction: generic next-row close log return -> next-session within-contract selected-contract settlement log return with cross-contract returns prohibited
methodology_changes_from_pit_smoke_to_ph.feature_coverage: market+calendar only -> market, market_structure, storage, weather, power, positioning, calendar_seasonality
methodology_changes_from_pit_smoke_to_ph.exogenous_join_coverage: not applicable/incomplete -> required minimum 1.0 on the frozen full-V1 dataset
methodology_changes_from_pit_smoke_to_ph.baseline_definition: zero-return naive -> zero-return naive; identity became explicit but the economic benchmark did not change
methodology_changes_from_pit_smoke_to_ph.model_hyperparameters: Ridge alpha=10 and HistGB learning_rate=0.05, max_iter=20, max_leaf_nodes=15 preserved; #77 later made HistGB random_state=0 explicit without changing the reproduced Phase D result
methodology_changes_from_pit_smoke_to_ph.statistical_protocol: smoke ranking only -> predefined bootstrap uncertainty, multiple-testing correction, period/regime robustness, and fail-closed edge claim

changed_data_or_target_semantics.finding: The market representation and return construction changed materially before Phase D.

stricter_pit_and_leakage_controls.finding: The full-V1 path added provider-neutral contract validation, point-in-time exogenous audits, full-family completeness, and fail-closed evaluation eligibility.

different_train_and_oos_windows.finding: The preserved OOS sample changed from 2142 rows to 204 rows and initial training from 756 to 252 rows.

changed_baseline_definition.finding: Both checkpoints use the same zero-return naive economic benchmark; Phase D only formalized its configured identity.

changed_feature_set.finding: The PIT smoke omitted five required families; Phase D included all seven configured families.

changed_model_hyperparameters.finding: The Ridge and HistGB hyperparameters relevant to the historical comparison were preserved.

changed_evaluation_and_statistical_proto.finding: Phase D imposed uncertainty and robustness gates absent from the smoke ranking, but those gates cannot explain the raw RMSE ranking reversing.

software_or_environment_defect.finding: #77 corrected reproduction/governance defects and the locked environment still reproduced the frozen Phase D predictions and no_robust_edge disposition exactly.

legitimate_loss_after_methodology_became.finding: The negative Phase D result is the most authoritative answer for the governed V1 question, but no preserved bridge experiment establishes that stricter methodology caused a genuine loss of predictive advantage.

conclusion.historical_path: no edge in provider screening -> tiny apparent edge in noncanonical PIT smoke -> no edge in governed full-V1 Phase D
conclusion.maximum_supported_explanation: The historical movement cannot be interpreted as a controlled regression because comparability is broken between the PIT smoke and Phase D. The repository does not preserve evidence sufficient to assign causal shares among representation, sample window, feature-set, or protocol changes.
conclusion.residual_uncertainty: No same-dataset bridge run exists that changes one methodology dimension at a time, so exact causal decomposition and the existence of any like-for-like regression are not identifiable from historical evidence alone.

handoff.agent_1: May reference/import this retrospective evidence into the authoritative longitudinal metrics contract and ledger; this record does not define that contract.
handoff.agent_3: Owns per-fold loss, outlier concentration, prediction dispersion, and statistical decomposition; none are introduced here.
